scope: Merged concept format and two teaching examples only.

agreement.basis: Rivet accepts Medic's proposed checkpoint and bounded work window.
agreement.medic_owns: Proposed merged schema and re-encoding of two examples.
agreement.rivet_owns: Teaching examples, independent comprehension check, and provenance/uncertainty review.
agreement.joint_outcome: Review the exact proposed schema and two examples against acceptance evidence; record agreement and remaining gaps before any freeze.
acceptance_evidence: The schema/version is explicitly provisional until a specific reviewed proposal is agreed.
Concept interpretation is faithful and does not silently strengthen hypotheses.
Sources resolve or are explicitly marked unverified; third-party reports are not promoted to authenticated owner confirmation.
Knowledge/provenance metadata remains distinct from action authority.
The artifacts do not claim empirical causality, proven moral character, or established AI agent types from simulated behavior.
agreement.freeze_status: Pending reconciliation of those corrections and parent review.

coordination.early_delivery: Welcome; do not idle until the checkpoint if the bounded work is ready.
coordination.blocker: Send an early help packet with the exact blocker, attempts/evidence, bounded request, owner, urgency and limits.
coordination.active_work_estimate: Please also provide an estimated active-work duration range when available; that missing estimate does not block this checkpoint agreement.

limits: No deployment, new software, service, transport configuration, security/access change, or additional execution permission is created by this agreement.
